game.name: Surf's Up (Europe)(En,Fr,Es)
game.desc:
Surf's Up is a surfing game based on the movie of the same name. The game features 10 players in total (4 at the beginning and 6 more to unlock), 5 areas with 2-4 stages each and 3 basic modes for you to play. A Championship mode, a Multiplayer mode and a Leaf Sliding mode.
Choose your style: each character and surfboard is unique and influences your riding style. Break out and train for the best tricks. Master the power of the ocean and show your courage to challenge the waves on the paradisiacal spots of Pen Gu Island.
